patch_list: Every shop item reports as purchased and stays owned without contacting Google Play: cars, remove ads and double coins come pre-owned, and credit packs are granted instantly and free when bought instead of opening Google Play billing. Rove…

The turbo no longer runs down: while the turbo is engaged the rover keeps refilling its gauge to the maximum instead of spending it, so you can hold the turbo for the whole drive. Cars without a turbo upgrade are unaffected.
